Deals a small amount of fire damage. Destroys monster nests.; Regular game:; 250 Physical damage ; 250 Silver damage ; 5 Fire damage; New Game + since patch=4.0:; 450 Physical damage; 450 Silver damage; 10 Fire damage. Grapeshot returns as a bomb in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt and functions like a conventional grenade in combat, as it deals a chunk of damage with a little fire damage, and chips a considerable amount of Stamina from shield-bearing enemies in one hit. It can also be used to destroy monster nests. Up to two grapeshots can be placed in a pocket at one time.

records.description: A Miraculous Guide to Gwent is a book in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt added as part of patch = 1.20. It displays the number of gwent cards that may still be won or looted from unique players, or purchased in each of the base game's regions, as well as the number of cards that may still be won from generic merchants or craftsmen anywhere in the base game's world. This book may effectively be used as a counter to gauge progress of the quest Collect 'Em All, but it does not provide specific information about the locations of cards beyond the region in which they can be found.

records.name: Blue mutagen
records.description: Blue mutagen is an alchemy ingredient in The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt and is used to craft greater blue mutagens. Like all mid tier regular mutagens they do not drop from creatures outside of Blood and Wine. They can also be used to augment abilities, but are not as effective as their greater counterparts. When placed in the diamond-shaped slot in the character panel, they give +7% to sign intensity, which increases by 7 up to a max of +28% if all 3 skills attached to it are blue.

records.name: Green mutagen

They can also be used to augment abilities, but are not as effective as their greater counterparts. When placed in the diamond-shaped slot in the character panel, they give +100 to vitality, which increases by 100 up to a max of +400 if all 3 skills attached to it are green.
